tools.name: read-xlsx-file
tools.description: Read an Excel .xlsx file and return its worksheets as JSON row data. Useful for inspecting spreadsheet contents, exported tables, or generated reports. Each worksheet is returned as a 2D array (rows of cells); empty cells are null, numbers/strings/booleans pass through, dates become ISO 8601 strings, formula cells become their cached result (or "=formula" text when no cached result), error cells become their error code (e.g. "#N/A"). Params: filePath (required, path of the .xlsx file), sheetName (optional, read only this tab), cellRange (optional, e.g. "A1:C5" to limit the read).

tools.name: write-xlsx-file
tools.description: Create a new Excel .xlsx file (or overwrite an existing one) from row-major JSON data. Accepts one or more worksheets; each worksheet is a 2D array of cell values (strings, numbers, booleans or null for empty cells). A string cell starting with "=" (e.g. "=SUM(A1:A3)") is stored as a live Excel formula. Params: filePath (required, output path), sheets (required, array of {name, rows}), overwrite (optional, false refuses to overwrite an existing file). Returns the path and per-sheet row/column counts.

tools.name: read-csv-file
tools.description: Read a CSV text file and return its content as JSON row data. Parses with fast-csv semantics: numeric-looking values become numbers, ISO-like dates become dates, empty fields become null. Useful for consuming CSV exports or data dumps as structured data. Params: filePath (required), delimiter (optional, single char, default ","), sheetName (optional, internal worksheet name, default "Sheet1").

tools.name: write-csv-file
tools.description: Write a CSV text file from row-major JSON data. Each inner array is one CSV record; values may be strings, numbers, booleans or null (empty field). The file is written as UTF-8. Params: filePath (required, output path), rows (required, 2D array), delimiter (optional, single char, default ","), sheetName (optional, default "Sheet1"). Returns the written path and row/column counts.
